name: – Marcos Ros Sempere – § 27/2
title: REPORT on a new strategy for media literacy and digital learning
part_text: ‘calls on the Commission to strengthen support for traditional media at European, national, regional, and local level, given their essential role in informing citizens, including by promoting fair remuneration for journalistic content and ensuring sustainable funding, notably through programmes such as the future AgoraEU programme;’
